build_quasi_dense_track_head: build a QuasiDenseTrackHead model with roi_extractor and embed_head config dicts for multi-object tracking
init_embed_head: initialize the embed_head and roi_extractor submodules from config dicts using MODELS registry
init_assigner_sampler: initialize bbox_assigner and bbox_sampler from train_cfg using TASK_UTILS registry for training
extract_roi_feats: extract roi features from multi-level image features and bounding boxes using roi_extractor
loss_tracking_head: calculate tracking losses between key and reference frame features using embed_head and sampling results
